items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: The Ed Sullivan Show two or three times, as I can remember. We played a lot

ctx.x: He had these three big records that were making it. He had a lot of money coming in. And other things... Just everything was going his way, and everything went his way for the next, oh, five years, in which we played all over the United States and we did all kinds of shows. The Ed Sullivan Show two or three times, as I can remember. We played a lot
